pages.title: Buffer Tank
pages.text: A weak acid and its salt, mixed to a ratio: the pH it holds is set by that ratio, and it will not budge.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.
Set the salt-to-acid ratio. pH = pKa + log(ratio): each buffer must sit within 0.05 of its pH. Too far from 1 and there is no buffering left.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 3 fluid inputs, 1 and 1 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Ammonia Buffer, Phosphate Buffer.
